name: prompt-coach
description: Reviews each prompt before it is sent, against Anthropic's prompting guidance for the session's model and effort level. Coach mode shows the findings and lets you choose; auto mode applies them.

mode.title: Mode／模式
mode.description:
coach: show the review and let me choose. auto: apply it without asking. off: do nothing.
coach：顯示評審結果，由我決定怎麼送出。auto：不詢問，直接套用。off：不處理。

auto_style.title: Auto mode style／自動模式的做法
auto_style.description:
append: leave my words as typed and attach notes only Claude reads. rewrite: replace my prompt with the improved version.
append：保留我打的原文，附加只有 Claude 讀得到的補充。rewrite：把 prompt 換成改寫後的版本。

pass_score.title: Pass score／通過分數
pass_score.description:
Coach mode sends a prompt without asking when it scores at least this much (0-100).
教練模式下，分數達到這個值（0–100）就直接送出，不詢問。

backend.title: Review backend／評審後端
backend.description:
session: review through Claude Code's own connection (your plan, API key or cloud provider). api_key: review through the Messages API with the key below.
session：透過 Claude Code 自己的連線評審（你的訂閱方案、API key 或雲端供應商）。api_key：用下方的金鑰呼叫 Messages API 評審。

engine.title: Session review engine／session 的評審方式
engine.description:
fork: the session's own model reviews with the whole conversation in view, reusing its prompt cache. complete: a separate call that sees only a digest of the conversation.
fork：由 session 的模型帶著完整對話評審，沿用 prompt cache。complete：另外呼叫一次，只看得到對話摘要。

fork_effort.title: Effort of a fork review／fork 評審的 effort
fork_effort.description:
low: the review asks for low effort, the quickest. session: it names no level and runs at the session's; choose this when your model or provider takes effort for a whole request only, where a different level writes the conversation to the prompt cache again.
low：評審指定低 effort，最快。session：不指定，照 session 的 effort 執行；你的模型或供應商只能對整個請求設定 effort 時選這個，否則每次評審會把對話重寫一份 prompt cache。

review_model.title: Review model／評審模型
review_model.description:
Model for the complete engine and the api_key backend: session (the model the session runs), haiku, sonnet, opus, fable, or a full model id.
complete 與 api_key 後端用的模型：session（session 正在用的模型）、haiku、sonnet、opus、fable，或完整模型 ID。

api_key.title: Anthropic API key／Anthropic API 金鑰
api_key.description:
Used only by the api_key backend. The PROMPT_COACH_API_KEY environment variable works too.
只有 api_key 後端會用。也可以改設環境變數 PROMPT_COACH_API_KEY。

api_base_url.title: API base URL／API 網址
api_base_url.description:
Where the api_key backend sends requests.
api_key 後端送出請求的網址。

timeout_seconds.title: Review timeout (seconds)／評審逾時（秒）
timeout_seconds.description:
When a review takes longer than this, the prompt is sent as typed.
評審超過這個秒數，就照原文送出。

min_chars.title: Shortest prompt to review／最短評審長度
min_chars.description:
Prompts shorter than this many characters skip the model review. The instant pattern check still runs.
比這個字元數短的 prompt 不呼叫模型評審，即時掃描照常執行。

fork_max_tokens.title: Largest conversation to fork／fork 的對話上限
fork_max_tokens.description:
Past this many context tokens the review uses the complete engine, so its cost stops growing with the conversation.
對話超過這個 context tokens 數時改用 complete，評審成本就不會跟著對話成長。

headless.title: Review prompts from claude -p and the SDK／評審 claude -p 與 SDK 的 prompt
headless.description:
Off by default: only prompts typed at the prompt box are reviewed. Coach mode never holds a headless prompt.
預設關閉：只評審在輸入框打的 prompt。教練模式不會攔住無頭模式的 prompt。

language.title: Interface language／介面語言
language.description:
Language of the card, the notes in the transcript, the command output and the names of these settings in /config.
卡片、對話紀錄裡的附註、指令輸出，以及 /config 裡這些設定的名稱與說明所用的語言。
